children: Science Applications International reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $1.88 billion, up about 6.3% year-over-year (5.3% organic) and narrowed to net income of $102 million. Adjusted EBITDA was $193 million (10.3% of revenues) and adjusted diluted earnings per share were $3.01 for the quarter. The company raised its fiscal 2027 guidance for revenue, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA margin and adjusted diluted EPS while reiterating free cash flow guidance.
Revenue: $1.88 billion for the three months ended July 31, 2026, up ~6.3% year-over-year (5.3% organic).
Operating income: $152 million; operating margin of 8.1%.
Net income: $102 million for the quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS: $3.01 for the quarter (adjusted diluted EPS prior-year quarter $3.63).
Adjusted EBITDA: $193 million (10.3% of revenues); adjusted EBITDA guidance raised to $750M–$755M for FY27 with margin guidance 10.3%–10.5%.

Bookings and backlog: Net bookings of approximately $1.2 billion for the quarter, quarterly book-to-bill ratio of 0.6 and trailing twelve months book-to-bill of 0.8; estimated backlog approximately $22.1 billion (about $3.8 billion funded).

Notable contract awards during the quarter include a ~ $400 million five-year recompete supporting a U.S. Intelligence Agency, a ~ $330 million five-year contract supporting the U.S. Army for SoS/SE/LVC and modeling & simulation work, and a ~ $130 million five-year contract supporting U.S. Navy airborne electronic warfare systems testing and acquisition support.

Notable awards subsequent to period end include a ~ $740 million five-year recompete with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security for CBP operations and maintenance, and placement on the COMET IDIQ with MSIC (estimated $14 billion total vehicle).
Segment performance: Defense and Intelligence revenues $1,449 million (adjusted operating margin 9.5%); Civilian revenues $431 million (adjusted operating margin 13.0%).

Cash and capital deployment: Operating cash flow $146 million for the quarter and free cash flow $131 million; company repurchased $90 million of shares and paid $16 million in dividends during the quarter; MARPA facility increased to $400 million post-quarter.
